fix_tickets.issue: Audience and differentiation appear in a caption over a full page.
fix_tickets.replacement: Hold a concise, high-contrast audience and promise card for at least three seconds.
fix_tickets.expected_result: First-time viewers can identify audience and promise immediately.
fix_tickets.verification: Show the unobstructed card for the full hold in the final export.

fix_tickets.issue: The typed correction is visible but small and competes with subtitles.
fix_tickets.replacement: Show the Not quite selection, caret, full typed correction, and changed reflection in one uninterrupted close shot.
fix_tickets.expected_result: The correction reads as the user’s own action.
fix_tickets.verification: Continuous recording with no transition between selection, typing, and updated card.

fix_tickets.issue: All consent details are together but small at full-page scale.
fix_tickets.replacement: Hold a tighter view that simultaneously shows audience, alias, question, exclusion note, unchecked consent, and cancel for at least four seconds.
fix_tickets.expected_result: The viewer can inspect scope and decline without pausing.
fix_tickets.verification: One shot retains the unchanged unchecked state and cancel label throughout.

fix_tickets.issue: Prepared and planned status disclosures compete with interface content.
fix_tickets.replacement: Use clear Planned / not connected and Illustrative example / no live activity labels.
fix_tickets.expected_result: Proposed roles stay distinct from demonstrated functionality.
fix_tickets.verification: Labels remain legible in the 1080p export.
